items.html: *The lights do not stand in the secret of the pregnancy but seven months, and afterwards they are completed to be corrected. And the sparks are completed after nine months, and the vessels are completed after twelve months. Hence you will find three pregnancies that there are in the world: the time of seven, of nine, and of twelve. As mentioned in the Gemara, in that matter of one who tarried twelve months of the year, and Rabba Tosfa'a declared him fit. (Yevamot 80b).
